text: The blanks likely read: "Did Augustus III of Poland buy a Correggio in 1746?" — and the answer is yes, Augustus III acquired Correggio's large Nativity altarpiece (the "Notte") in 1746, not a small penitent figure. So the figure named "Antonio" in the garbled text is probably a misrendering, and the purchase is the Dresden Nativity. CONFIDENCE: 70
